title: Lior and the Choir
author: Ivo Eriksen
blurb: Tamsin Brightwater, a bone-carver who hears the dead, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
